subject: SIG: Request for rollback authority matrix and ephemeral key snapshots
messages:
From: Matt Rivera <matt.rivera@sigassess.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeFin Compliance <compliance@acmefin.com>
Date: 2028-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up: ephemeral key snapshots and rollback authority

Irene / Jordan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of the SIG review we're collecting a short set of artifacts to validate your Secure SDLC controls related to emergency rollbacks and ephemeral credential usage. Specifically AcmeFin needs:

- A current rollback authority matrix that lists roles, approval steps, and escalation contacts for production rollbacks in the last 12 months.
- A time-bound snapshot of ephemeral key issuance (signed tokens, short-lived KMS keys) for the last 90 days, with anonymized identifiers (no private key material) and the issuing principal.
- CI/CD run logs showing a sample emergency rollback deployment and the approval trail for that job.

Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow whether you can provide these items, and any expected delivery ETA? If there are gap items we can scope compensating controls.

Thanks,
Matt Rivera
Senior Assessor — Sigma Security
sigassess.com

(attachment: SIG-questionnaire-v2.pdf)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Matt Rivera <matt.rivera@sigassess.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: ephemeral key snapshots and rollback authority

Matt —

We can support this request. High-level answers below and we'll follow with artifacts and a short narrative for the assessor.

- Rollback authority matrix: we maintain a spreadsheet listing roles (on-call eng, SRE lead, product owner, security on-call), required approvals, and documented runbooks. We will deliver the redacted matrix (no personal phone numbers) and a change log showing last updates.
- Ephemeral key snapshots (90 days): we can export token issuance records from our KMS + CI runner metadata; we will strip actual secret blobs and provide hashed IDs, issuance timestamps, TTLs, and issuing principal/service account names.
- CI/CD run logs: we will include the runlog for the Oct 13 emergency rollback which contains the Git SHA, job id, approver username, and pipeline step timestamps. Sensitive logs will be redacted.

We will compile the artifacts into a single package and share a Drive folder link by tomorrow 1400 PDT. If you need additional provenance (signatures, JIRA link to the incident), let us know and we'll attach.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Irene / Grace —

Quick inventory after talking to SRE and CI owners:

Available now (can be sanitized and exported):
- rollback_authority_matrix.xlsx (includes role, required approvers, escalation flow, last review date)
- ci_pipeline_runlog-20281013.txt (full job run output for the rollback)
- kms_issue_index.csv (hashed key ids, issuing principal, TTLs, creation timestamps)

Gaps / notes:
- We don't currently keep a long-term signed snapshot of ephemeral key material; we maintain logs in KMS for 90 days per policy. For SIG we can produce a tarball of the 90-day index with hashes and link to the KMS audit stream, but not the private key contents.
- The rollback matrix references pager duty numbers for some staff — we'll redact PII and include role-based contact channels instead.

Proposed acceptance criteria for the assessor: records must include timestamps, principal identity (service account or short username), and a pipeline job id that correlates to the rollback event. That should satisfy the SIG reviewer.

I'll prepare the exports and drop them in the shared Drive. Attaching a stub: (attachment stub: export_manifest.txt)

—Jordan
Senior SRE Manager

Subject: SIG artifacts: rollback authority matrix and ephemeral key snapshot (package delivered)

Matt / AcmeFin team —

Per our commitment, we've shared a curated package for your review. Contents and delivery details below: 

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEXAMPLE
HubSpot ticket: HS-89234

Attachments delivered: 
- rollback_authority_matrix.xlsx (redacted contact PII, includes review history and last change)
- ephemeral_key_snapshot-20281013.tar.gz (index of 90 days of key issuance records; no secret material included; hashes map to issuing principals)
- ci_pipeline_runlog-20281013.txt (emergency rollback run log; approver usernames and job ids visible; sensitive env var values redacted)
- export_manifest.txt (list of files and sanitization notes)

Summary: 
- The rollback matrix shows a 3-tier approval for production rollbacks (SRE lead + Product + Security on-call) with documented canary/rollback steps.
- KMS indexes include issuance timestamp, TTL, and issuing principal; these are exported as hashed identifiers to preserve key material confidentiality.
- Pipeline run logs include the job id (job-4829), Git SHA, and approver principal for the Oct 13 emergency rollback; we have also linked the incident JIRA (INC-7231) in the Drive notes.

If you need a short (15 minute) walkthrough of the artifacts with one of our SREs to explain mapping between KMS audit entries and pipeline jobs, we can schedule tomorrow morning. Otherwise, please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts meet SIG scope.

Thanks — appreciate the close coordination.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
